C0588.title: Mengyu Aerospace Science Education Base (Hainan Wenchang) Co., Ltd. Price Fraud Case
C0588.summary: In 2024, the Wenchang Municipal Market Supervision Bureau inspected online sales of Wenchang rocket-launch viewing tickets on the Douyin platform and found that Mengyu Aerospace Science Education Base (Hainan Wenchang) Co., Ltd. sold aerospace launch viewing packages with comparison pricing, including displays such as "¥3999 ¥5999" and "¥7999 ¥14999." The two ticket packages had never been sold at the higher comparison prices, and no source basis was disclosed for those comparison prices. The conduct constituted price fraud, and the company was fined RMB 60,000.
